I have this fresh theory that Vcat is to Base what Zcat has been to solana/stonks. 

The ignition.

Base has had fumble after fumble, so who knows how they’re gonna fuck this up, but this one is very hard to.

As far as I know they have no refraction token runners at all, the fresh new meta we are all loving: they tons of launchpads, lots of shovels, no gold.

They also have an impressive lack of “killer apps” and VVV is in my humble opinion the most obvious gem on their poverbial and scuffed crown. Y’all know it’s been a core holding of mine for a long time now.

There’s more. When I followed the Zcat account, I saw so many big accounts and big names in those furst followers. Some really smart ones too. Looks prepped.

It’s also obviously the only one that makes more sense on base than Solana/RH: you wanna stake your VVV rewards. You wanna use the app. Try the models. Enjoy true private LLM usage. Rewards so far have been nuts, should incentivize holding, paired with the quality of the token you’re getting.

If done right, if embraced properly from both Base and VVV higher ups, it can be an insanely good and sticky onboarding machine. Like neerkat for Near this week. If snubbed, it will be a Tensor level fumble. Content quality will matter a lot too, too early to have an opinion there, but branding looks ok.

People want to have nobrainer fun, and then slowly be onbaorded to these ecosystems, effortlessly. The model works, we’re seeing that every day.

For all these reasons, I bridged over, grabbed a fair chunk, and will give Base this one shot to see if they’re finally in touch with where the puck is going. 

This could just be the beginning.
